notes: Manual pictures are low-resolution; piece-to-piece assignment in steps 3-10 (which plates, sills, panels sit on which) is a best interpretation, so most ports are null.

The booklet really builds three separate things: (1) the police car (b1-b48, plus the sticker sheet b56 joined to its tiles), (2) the roadside pole with loudhailer and gauge panel (b49-b54), and (3) the police minifigure, which carries the radio (b55). The radio is held in the minifigure's hand, and the minifigure's hat, head, torso and legs are not in the official parts list, so they are not nodes. The radio therefore has no connection to any listed part. These groups are separate by design and are not an error.
The exact attachment points of the clip plate and bar on the pole's antenna are uncertain.
The sticker sheet (b56) is joined to the car tiles (b7, b21, b39) where stickers are applied. The manual doesn't show exactly which tile gets which sticker, so this placement is an assumption.
The two roof antennas are the white lever pieces (298c02). The wheels are pinned to the wheel-holder plates in the final step, so they are revolute.
